formatNote: #395 (storyboard format and film-make) is not built yet. This file uses the fields #395 lists (scene setup, shots with camera, actors and duration, audio cues, titles, transitions, output) and the verbs that exist today: harness `scene start <name> [hour] [weather]`, `camera orbit|follow x y z size seconds`, actor steps walk|run|enter|drive|exit|use|wait. Fields marked `build` name what is missing. When #395 lands, convert this file to its schema and move it to video/trailer-571.json.
title: Life Framework trailer
session: node agent-box/session.mjs up --clients 3 --mission playtest --profile full --res 1920x1080 --sound --wait --priority low
shootAfter: M2 polish and the #679 visual QA sweep. Every shot's `blockedBy` issues must be closed, or the shot swapped for its `fallback`.

output.name: vertical
output.note: #571 asks for a 9:16 version. A 1080x1920 client window is untested (docs/film-pipeline.md). Every shot keeps its subject in the centre third so a 9:16 crop works from the 16:9 take.

lookDefaults.hourNote: agent-box/shots.mjs GOLDEN_HOUR (local hour) used for every gallery shot

cameraModes.orbit: exists: `camera orbit x y z radius seconds`, a 140 degree arc on the +z side, 5 m up, looking at the point + 1.2 m. Works for fronts that face +z (areas.json front 0).
cameraModes.orbitAzimuth: build (#392): orbit with a centre azimuth and height, for fronts at 90, 180 or 270.
cameraModes.follow: exists: `camera follow x y z distance seconds`, swings 160 degrees round the vehicle nearest the point, 3 m up. Wait 2 s after a spawn so the vehicle has streamed in.
cameraModes.static: build (#392): a fixed camera at a position, looking at a point, for N seconds.
cameraModes.drone: build (#392): a keyed path between two or more positions with easing. LF_FilmCameraPath already holds the keys; it needs a harness verb.
cameraModes.firstPerson: exists for a player client (its own camera). Needs the clean-frame toggle (#392: HUD and hints off on the player view) unless the shot shows a UI on purpose.
cameraModes.still: exists: `tools\cli shots area <name>` writes golden-hour clean stills (no HUD). Post adds a slow push in.

actorKinds.client: A real player client driven by the harness (`stand`, `use`, pose) or by an agent-box proof. Clothed, has a player identity, every action works.
actorKinds.puppet: LF_FilmActor on a step list. In underwear today (features.md: no loadout); a clothed outfit is a build item for #393. Driving works only as a physics-velocity drive at a steady speed.
